_comment: Who judges a criterion. 'llm-judge' (the judge cascade) is the default. Decision models are listed
here as candidates from the 2026-10-14 provider scan and are all OFF until chosen; see
docs/training-arena.md §5.5. A criterion can name one ({text, evaluator}), or a `routes` pattern can
send matching criteria to one. A disabled choice falls back to llm-judge and the verdict says so.
eu: false marks a provider outside the EU. Such an entry stays off unless it also carries
signed_off: true (CLAUDE.md §0.3). Keys must exist in Secrets Manager before an entry is switched on.

evaluators.name: eu-jev
evaluators.note: Jev-compatible decision model, Hetzner Germany, DPA published. Yes/no questions return a probability; answers between 0.2 and 0.8 are escalated to llm-judge. Limits: 8 questions per request, 240 requests and ~80k input tokens per minute.

evaluators.name: typesafe-jev
evaluators.note: The original Jev (TypeSafe AI). US-hosted: stays off unless signed_off is added after a DPA / transfer review.

evaluators.name: qwen3guard-ovh
evaluators.note: Safety classifier (incl. Suicide & Self-Harm), OVH Gravelines, free beta. Answers 'Safety: Safe|Unsafe'. The exact OVH model id must be checked in the catalogue before switching on.

evaluators.name: mistral-moderation
evaluators.note: Moderation scores per category; 'health' fits a dosing-advice criterion. Whether moderation is served on the EU endpoint is unverified.
